*   `?g B8`: The main concept is "Expression – Quote / Talking / Words" (B8).
    *   `!r F11`: A sub-concept (red group) is "One / Unit / Number" (F11).
    *   `!b Blue`: A sub-concept (blue group) is "Blue" (Color swatch).

    *   Main Concept: A word, a quote, a phrase, a saying, a title, or a specific piece of speech (B8).
    *   Red Sub-concept: Single, one, first (F11).
    *   Blue Sub-concept: Blue.

    *   "Blue" + "One" + "Phrase/Word/Quote" (B8).

        *   "Once in a blue moon" (A phrase/idiom).
